'''Darth Shattra''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who [[Death/Legends|died]] long before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Darth Shattra was killed by [[Jicoln Cadera]], a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] from [[Clan Ordo]]. Jincoln took Darth Shattra's skull as a trophy.<ref name="TOR" />
